newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - steady - off 0.20 cent. Drop in cash beef Wednesday and more long liquidation in futures should pressure cattle. However, correction from Wednesday's drop likely.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady - Cash firm and corn steady-weak.
HOGS - steady - off 0.20 cent. Pressure likely from lower cash pork prices Wednesday and expected lower cash hogs Thursday. However, correction likely after Wednesday's drop.
PORK BELLIES - steady - off 0.25. Weak cash bearish, but declining hog slaughter may provide support.
